messages:
maria: heads-up — canary for feature `unified-routing` (10% audience) just spiked 5xx to 6.2% (threshold 1.5%). I think we should flip the canary off for now. who is allowed to do the flip and what audit note do we need? /cc @jon @lee :eyes:

jon: saw the alert. link to the runbook? i'll stand by to approve if ops gives the thumbs up. do we need PM/EM approval or is oncall enough?

lee: runbook: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/feature-flip-v2 — section "canary emergency disable" covers steps. short answer: eng-sre or oncall with "toggle" perm can flip. product approval preferred if >30% audience; at 10% canary oncall is fine. Also we require an audit annotation with an incident id or PR link.

maria: thanks. creating INC-1234 now for the spike and adding diagnostics. who will actually run the command? i can if people confirm.

ops-runbook: note: prefer scoped disable over global. use the canary-only endpoint or `redwoodctl` to limit blast radius. annotate with `incident:<ID>` and `author:<your-handle>` for telemetry. automated rollback hooks require the note to match pattern `INC-\d+`.

lee: recommended command (use `redwoodctl` where possible):
```bash
redwoodctl feature disable unified-routing --scope canary --note "INC-1234: high 5xx spike"
# or via control plane API
curl -X POST \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  https://control.redwood.internal/v1/flags/unified-routing/actions \
  -d '{"action":"disable","scope":"canary","annot":"INC-1234 - spike"}'
```

zane: security check: please also include `approver:<name>` in the note if someone from product/security signs off. we need the KMS keyholder recorded for audit if a rollback requires private key access. :lock:

jon: i'll be the watcher post-flip. please also post the logs id and any fallback latency numbers.

maria: doing the flip now. prechecks: traffic reroute verified, downstream quota ok, canary cohort mapping confirmed. flipping in 3...2...1

sre-bot: automated action recorded: user=maria action=disable flag=unified-routing scope=canary note="INC-1234: high 5xx spike" audit_id=audit-8fb3 timestamp=2938456425

maria: flipped canary off. audit id audit-8fb3. immediate 5xx rate dropped to 0.9% in the next 2m. sending graphs to INC-1234. :white_check_mark:

jon: confirmed seeing drop on dashboards. adding short postmortem outline to the ticket. can you add which deploys rolled in the last 30m?

maria: added deploy hashes to the incident: deploys: backend@f3a2, router@b21c, config rollout at 12:01 UTC.

lee: reminder: do NOT flip global until PM approves. if we need a broader rollback, follow the runbook escalation (page has the explicit PM contact list).

zane: logged approval via slack thread for security audit: approver=jon. recorded in incident.

ops-runbook: next steps: keep canary disabled until INC-1234 RCA complete or a safe, limited re-rollout is validated. add `re-enable-playbook` checklist entry for QA signoff.

maria: assigning @jon as watcher for 30m, @lee for rollback readiness. i'll draft a short RCA after we stabilize. thanks everyone. :pray:
